MERGE (f)-[rel:HAS_TAINT_EVIDENCE]->(ev) SET ...`, NOT from the port or family name. HAS_TAINT_EVIDENCE is the only type this writer can emit (static token in the template, kept out of any per-row substitution). Each endpoint is the extractor's row identity: source the Function uid the collector resolved, target the row uid taint.codeTaintEvidenceUID derives as facts.StableID over function_uid, source_line, sink_line, sink_kind, source_kind, and binding. Exactly two edges: the http-request to sql-exec flow in handlePayment (source_line 12, sink_line 18) and the queue-message to command-exec flow in refundPayment (source_line 31, sink_line 40). The tombstoned voidPayment finding contributes nothing on purpose -- the extractor skips tombstones before decoding, so a deleted flow reaches neither the rows nor the quarantine count. kind, sink_kind, and source_kind ride as Properties pins (the template SETs them as plain strings from the row); scope_id, generation_id, and evidence_source are writer-stamped per run and cannot be pinned statically.
